author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
We take a close look at two examples of Lord of the Rings swords made by Weta Workshop: Faramir's unnamed sword and the legendary Shards of Narsil! Despite the difference in roles they play in the Lord of the Rings trilogy, both swords showcase the beautiful design and fine detail that still holds up after a quarter century. 

Learn more about these props and see more details at: https://propstoreauction.com/auctions/catalog/id/496

Shot by Josh Self and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
